name: Nullweaver
lore: An eccentric masked rift tailor. Weak pins become deadly lines when carefully placed; aim beyond foes, rotate the seam, and catch them on triangle edges.

primary.name: Stitch Reality
primary.description: Place a pin up to 280 away for 18 damage in a tiny area. Two pins flash a 25.2-damage seam; a third replaces the oldest. Pins over 600 apart lose their link. Walls block travel.

secondary.name: Quarter Turn
secondary.description: Rotate the line between two pins by 90 degrees over 0.6s. Its sweeping seam hits each foe once. Requires two pins.

special.name: Impossible Hem
special.description: Hold Space to place a triangle freely with mouse or touch aim; release to cast. After a 0.65s warning, its rotating edges fire in sequence for 36 damage per edge. The empty centre is safe; careful placement can catch a foe twice.

passive: Needle Frost: Rift seams slow struck enemies by 20% for 1s after level 5.

technique.name: Broad Seam
technique.description: Sweep twice as wide, but reduce damage from 42 to 30.

final_technique.name: Unravel
final_technique.description: Replace precise triangle edges with three smaller delayed rift bursts in a fan. Easier to land, less potential damage.

attack.name: Unravel
attack.description: Three 60-radius rifts burst after 0.6–0.9s, dealing 26 each. Spread them across foes or overlap them.
